31813-(R1873).s: The bill amends the Dutch Nationality Act to restrict multiple nationality, require Dutch language knowledge for naturalisation in the Antilles and Aruba, allow nationality withdrawal after serious criminal conviction, and extend an option right to certain children of Dutch mothers. It also makes technical changes.
31813-(R1873).j: The memorandum justifies withdrawal after conviction as an order measure requiring independent assessment of all relevant facts and circumstances, and the Minister's advice on option cases as ensuring consistent judgement.
q: This concerns an order measure that must be preceded by an independent assessment of all relevant facts and circumstances.
Het gaat hier om een ordemaatregel waaraan een zelfstandige beoordeling van alle relevante feiten en omstandigheden vooraf dient te gaan.
d: authority decides option after advice from Minister
Artikel I, onderdeel G (art. 14 RWN, lid 2 and 3)
Minister may withdraw nationality after conviction or danger to security
Artikel I, onderdeel G (art. 14 RWN, lid 4)
Crown may deviate from re-acquisition bar in special cases after advice of Raad van State
p: Artikel I, onderdeel G (art. 14 RWN, lid 2 and 3)

Minister may withdraw nationality of persons convicted of listed offences or whom there are serious suspicions pose a security danger, a discretionary power affecting citizens' status with limited judicial safeguards stated in the text.
Authority assesses whether renunciation of another nationality can reasonably be demanded, with Minister's advice that is non-binding but must be motivated if departed from.

parties: Asks the government to explain the rationale for exemptions from the renunciation requirement and the position on European harmonisation of nationality law.
Questions the rationale for reimposing the renunciation requirement on a small optant category and asks about the handling of revocation decisions and appeal.
These members ask whether the government can further justify why the renunciation requirement is reinstated for this small category.
Deze leden vragen of de regering nader kan motiveren waarom voor deze kleine categorie de afstandsplicht weer in stelling wordt gebracht.
Opposes symbolic nationality policy and asks whether every revocation of nationality is subject to judicial review, warning that subjective criteria could lose meaning under public pressure.
These members ask whether every revocation of nationality is subject to judicial review.
Deze leden vragen of iedere ontneming van nationaliteit, onderworpen is aan een rechterlijke toets.
Asks for precise criteria for non-binding ministerial advice, the discretion of the minister in revocation decisions, and the legal basis for limits on revocation under the European Convention.
Article 6, third paragraph describes that if an optant believes renunciation cannot reasonably be required, the authority may ask the minister for advice.
Artikel 6, derde lid beschrijft dat indien een optant meent dat afstand redelijkerwijs niet van hem kan worden verlangd, de autoriteit de minister om advies kan vragen.
Argues that dual nationality undermines exclusive Dutch loyalty and asks for stricter rules and broader grounds for revocation.
Furthermore, the PVV members propose that the government work to amend or terminate the European Convention on Nationality in this regard.
Voorts stellen de leden van de PVV-fractie de regering in dit verband voor te bewerkstelligen dat het Europees Verdrag inzake nationaliteit ter zake wordt aangepast dan wel opgezegd.
Asks the government to justify why the renunciation rule applies only to one optant category and not others.
These members ask the government to explain why the proposed scheme applies only to the foreign national under Article 6, first paragraph, under e, and not to those under f and h.

Deze leden verzoeken de regering toe te lichten waarom de voorgestelde regeling enkel geldt voor de vreemdeling als bedoeld in artikel 6, eerste lid, onder e en niet voor de vreemdeling als bedoeld in artikel 6, eerste lid, onder f en h.
Asks who decides whether an effective link with the country of origin exists and whether the origin state may place claims on the individual.
These members ask whose judgment is ultimately decisive for the question of whether an effective link exists.
Deze leden vragen wiens oordeel tenslotte beslissend is voor het antwoord op de vraag óf er van een effectieve band sprake is.

v.summary: The Council of State advises on a bill amending the Dutch Nationality Act, mainly questioning the government's rationale for exempting some adult second-generation migrants born in the Kingdom from the renunciation requirement. The government's reply revises its reading of article 8 CRC, accepts requiring no renunciation for minor options, and explains why exemptions for those born in the Kingdom and for those married to a Dutch national are justified.
concerns: The Council questions the interpretation of article 8 CRC on the child's nationality and asks the government to reconsider it; the government revised its reading and now requires no renunciation for minors, while maintaining that the CRC is not violated strictly.

The Council asks why adult migrants born in the Kingdom are exempted from the renunciation requirement while others who lived there from age four are not, requesting better justification; the government expanded its explanation but kept the exemptions.
The Council gives editorial comments, including clarifying the considerans wording and explaining the implementation of article 8 RWN for the Caribbean islands, which the government adopted.

31924-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2008 departmental budget statutes of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) and the budget for its operating agencies, adjusting the authorised expenditure and receipts figures and fixing the outcome amounts in thousands of euros. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2008.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII)

31965-XV.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) and the budget statement for its business-operations services, in line with the Spring Memorandum. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force as 1 June 2009, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Having considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV)
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV)

32565-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science for the second supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations across primary, secondary, vocational, higher education, study finance and other articles. It contains no delegation of rule-making power; the attached memorandum explains budget shifts such as carry-overs and reallocations between articles.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

33090-XVI.s: The bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adjusting appropriations and expenditure figures in thousands of euros following the autumn budget memorandum. It takes effect from 1 December 2011, with retroactive effect if published later.
33090-XVI.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by underspending on several topics and extra funds for the mantelzorgcompliment, without any delegation of power.
q: This change concerns extra funds for the mantelzorgcompliment.
Deze mutatie betreft extra middelen voor het mantelzorgcompliment.

33805-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) and the budgets of the agencies (agentschappen) through the second supplementary budget (Najaarsnota), effective from 1 December 2013. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2013 is amended, as shown in the statement annexed to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33940-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) and its agencies, adding roughly 389.7 million euros in spending mutations including a large increase for the NVWA food safety inspectorate. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amended budget effective from 1 June 2014.
33940-XIII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increases by reference to an action plan to improve NVWA food chain supervision sent to parliament in December 2013.
q: To improve the NVWA's supervision of the food chain, an action plan was sent to the House of Representatives in December 2013.
Om het toezicht van de NVWA op de voedselketen te verbeteren is in december 2013 een plan van aanpak aan de Kamer aangeboden.

33992-(R2034).s: The bill approves the 2006 UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities for the entire Kingdom of the Netherlands, and enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad. The explanatory memorandum discusses the convention's implementation, direct and horizontal effect of its provisions, and how existing Dutch legislation such as the Wgbh/cz and the Wet bopz relates to it.
33992-(R2034).j: The memorandum justifies the approval by pointing to the convention's aim of inclusion and to the Netherlands' obligation to follow its provisions, not to any new executive delegation.
q: The Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities concluded in New York on 13 December 2006 ... is approved for the entire Kingdom.
Het op 13 december 2006 te New York tot stand gekomen Verdrag inzake de rechten van personen met een handicap ... wordt goedgekeurd voor het gehele Koninkrijk.

parties: Asks who weighs disproportionate burden against accommodation duties and how a provider can contest a proposed accommodation, raising questions about enforcement and dispute resolution.
When determining whether there is a disproportionate burden, a balancing is made between the interests of the person with a disability and the interests of the other party.
Bij het bepalen of er sprake is van een onevenredige belasting wordt een weging gemaakt tussen de belangen van de persoon met een handicap en de belangen van de wederpartij.
Asks why the government has not signed the optional protocol giving individual complaint rights and an inquiry power to the committee, which would strengthen legal protection.
The Human Rights Institute and the Alliance state that rulings in individual cases by the supervisory Committee increase the legal protection of persons with disabilities.
Het College voor de Rechten van de Mens en de Alliantie geven aan dat uitspraken in individuele zaken van het toezichthoudend Comité de rechtsbescherming van personen met een beperking vergroot.
Asks how the government will supervise lower governments' compliance and report to the UN committee, and questions budget cuts that could undermine implementation.
The SP members further ask the government how it will supervise compliance with the convention by lower governments.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering voorts hoe zij toezicht zal houden op naleving van het verdrag door lagere overheden.
Questions the necessity of seven interpretive declarations and whether the scope of the convention is clear, asking for justification.
They also ask for a detailed explanation.](Note: the CDA asks whether all seven interpretive declarations are necessary.)
Zij vragen ook om een uitgebreide toelichting.
Asks the government to justify the number of interpretive declarations and to clarify the terminology of reasonable accommodation, which leaves room for subjective interpretation.
These members are of the view that the terminology used leaves too much room for subjective interpretation.
Genoemde leden zijn van mening dat de gehanteerde terminologie teveel ruimte laat voor subjectieve interpretaties.
Welcomes ratification and asks about the government's wider agenda for improving the position of persons with disabilities.
These members finally wish to ask the government about its agenda for further improving the position of persons with disabilities in Dutch society.
Genoemde leden willen de regering tot slot vragen naar haar agenda voor de verdere verbetering van de positie van mensen met een beperking in de Nederlandse samenleving.
Criticizes the lack of ambition in the bills and asks whether the government's humanitarian aid and housing accessibility sufficiently protect the rights of persons with disabilities.
Unfortunately these members note that the bills to anchor this UN convention in the Netherlands show too little ambition.
Helaas constateren deze leden dat de wetsvoorstellen om dit VN-verdrag in Nederland te verankeren te weinig ambitie uitstraalt.

Asks what the financial consequences are if courts give convention-conform interpretations to provisions without direct effect, and whether the government's expected judicial restraint is well founded.
What happens if the court does not go along with the government's desired 'wide margin of policy discretion' when applying articles 9, 19 and 25?
Wat gebeurt er als de rechter niet meegaat in de door de regering gewenste «grote mate van beleidsruimte» bij het toepassen van de artikelen 9, 19 en 25?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities but raises concerns about the scope of reasonable accommodation, the direct effect of its provisions, the exclusion of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba without a deadline, and several interpretative declarations that may amount to hidden reservations. The government's reply accepts some points, adds clarifications on direct effect, policy discretion and a timeline for the islands, and defends its declarations while adjusting their wording.
concerns: The Council warns that the rule on reasonable accommodation may have far-reaching financial effects and asks the government to explain whether it has direct effect and how courts will assess it.
The Council asks the government to state explicitly whether each provision of the Convention is directly applicable, given the risk that programmatic rights become enforceable through courts.
The Council asks for a concrete deadline for extending the Convention to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, since its fundamental-rights character makes indefinite exclusion hard to justify.
The Council finds several interpretative declarations (on Article 10, Article 23 and related provisions) insufficiently defined and in substance reservations that must be justified or clarified.
The Council notes gaps and outdated references in the explanatory memorandum and asks for them to be corrected and supplemented.

34350-XVI.s: This is a bill amending the 2015 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adjusting expenditure and revenue across policy and non-policy articles, in connection with the autumn budget memorandum. The explanatory memorandum describes budget reallocations and carry-overs to 2016 and 2017 for items such as health prevention subsidies and training programmes.
34350-XVI.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to lower-than-budgeted uptake of schemes, shifts between articles and years, and a terminated subsidy relationship; it gives no justification for new executive powers.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2015 is amended, as shown in the statement annexed to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34417-(R2068).s: The bill approves for the Caribbean Netherlands, Curaçao and Sint Maarten a 2009 tax information exchange treaty between the Kingdom, on behalf of the Netherlands Antilles, and the Cayman Islands. It enters into force the day after the Staatsblad publication.
q: The Treaty concluded at Willemstad on 29 October 2009 ... is approved for the Caribbean part of the Netherlands, Curaçao and Sint Maarten.
Het op 29 oktober 2009 te Willemstad tot stand gekomen Verdrag ... wordt goedgekeurd voor het Caribische deel van Nederland, Curaçao en Sint Maarten.

parties: Asks about the long delay before submission, the reasons for on-request rather than automatic exchange, and the status of the side letter on the protocol clause.
What is the status of such an exchange of letters? To what extent is information exchange still hindered?
Wat is de status van zo'n briefwisseling? In hoeverre wordt de informatie-uitwisseling nu nog belemmerd?
Has no further questions or comments on the bill.
They have no further questions or comments on this.
Zij hebben daarbij geen nadere vragen of opmerkingen.
Asks why exchange is on request instead of automatic, whether the requested state can refuse, and asks for the side letter and the basis of the protocol clause to be explained.
Can the government send this exchange of letters to the Chamber?
Kan de regering deze briefwisseling naar de Kamer sturen?
Questions why a treaty is being ratified for a state that no longer exists and asks why the treaty lacks automatic exchange and reflection on reservations.
These members ask the government why tax treaties still need to be ratified for a country that has not existed for more than five years.
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom er nog belastingverdragen geratificeerd moeten worden voor een land dat al ruim vijf jaar niet meer bestaat.
Questions the added value of the treaty with a tax haven, whether beneficial owners will be disclosed, and the image risk after the Panama Papers.
Could approval of this treaty in the current context not lead to reputational damage?
Zou goedkeuring van dit verdrag in de huidige context niet kunnen leiden tot imagoschade?
Broadly supports the bill but asks why Aruba is excluded and whether exceptions could open avenues for tax avoidance.
Is it conceivable that an exceptional position for Aruba leads to or contributes to opening or keeping open tax avoidance and evasion routes?
Is het denkbaar dat een uitzonderingspositie voor Aruba leidt tot of bijdraagt aan het openen of openhouden van fiscale ontwijkings- en ontduikingsroutes?

34485-XV.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the budget statement of its agency, adjusting appropriations mainly following the Spring Memorandum. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and enters into force on 1 June 2016 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
34485-XV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by new incidental and temporary tasks for the agency, such as the holiday-day claims scheme following a Council of State ruling, and higher closure work on the ESF programme.
q: In summary, the differences between the draft budget and the first supplementary budget come down to additional (incidental and temporary) tasks that arose for the Agency after the draft budget was prepared.

Samengevat komen de geconstateerde verschillen tussen ontwerpbegroting en eerste suppletoire begroting er op neer dat na opstellen van de ontwerpbegroting er aanvullende (incidentele en tijdelijke) taken op het Agentschap zijn afgekomen

34620-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) and the related agency budget, effective from 1 December 2016, following the Autumn Memorandum. The explanatory memorandum explains cost adjustments such as higher SVB costs, lower training budgets for physician assistants and youth care, and changes in care-insurance and care-office spending.
q: The budget for training as a nurse practitioner/physician assistant is reduced by €16.3 million.
Het budget ten behoeve van de opleiding tot verpleegkundig specialist/ physician assistant wordt met € 16,3 miljoen verlaagd.

34725-VIII.s: This is a supplementary budget law (slotwet) that amends the 2016 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budgets of the agencies DUO and the Nationaal Archief. It sets the final budget figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendments retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.

34845-XV.s: This bill amends the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the budget statement of its agency, as part of the autumn supplementary budget (Najaarsnota). It changes appropriations and receipts in amounts expressed in thousands of euros and takes effect from 1 December 2017 or, if published later, the day after publication with retroactive effect.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2017 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34950-VIII.s: This Slotwet (closing budget act) amends the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget statements of the agencies DUO and the National Archives to reflect actual spending. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35470-XIII.s: This Dutch supplementary budget act (Slotwet) amends the 2019 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate and the budgets of its agencies, setting realised figures against the estimates. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers and no oversight changes.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding budget schedule attached to this act.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35552-(R2148).s: The bill amends the Paspoortwet to align Dutch identity card rules with EU Regulation 2019/1157, including removing the exception to personal appearance for applicants of Dutch identity cards and adjusting fingerprint rules for replacement cards. It also sets out the regulation's implications for privacy and biometric data handling.
35552-(R2148).j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the need to implement the EU regulation and to combat identity card fraud, and notes that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is the supervisory authority.
q: This exception conflicts with the personal appearance requirement set out in the regulation and therefore lapses in article 28 for applications for a Dutch identity card.
Deze uitzondering is in strijd met de verschijningsplicht zoals neergelegd in de verordening en vervalt daarom in artikel 28 met betrekking tot aanvraag van een Nederlandse identiteitskaart.
d: Artikel I, A (Paspoortwet art. 2, vierde lid)
rules on production of identity documents

parties: The VVD supports the fraud-prevention aim but asks about the leftover stock of blank documents, fee increases, and mobile fingerprinting costs for citizens abroad.
They would like to put a number of questions to the government about this.
Graag willen zij de regering daar een aantal vragen over stellen.

The CDA asks how dignity-respecting procedures for elderly people will be ensured, whether the target group will be involved, how citizens will be informed about privacy and storage of biometric data, and about certificates, costs and procurement.
The CDA members also ask the government to involve the target group itself in these considerations.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering ook de doelgroep zelf bij deze afwegingen te betrekken.

GroenLinks worries that people who cannot appear in person due to illness will be excluded, asks for a legal right to an alternative, and asks how EU law applies in the Caribbean public bodies and other Kingdom countries.
They therefore consider it important that a suitable alternative is organised as quickly as possible in all municipalities, public bodies and the other countries of the Kingdom.
Daarom vinden zij het van belang dat er zo snel mogelijk een passend alternatief in alle gemeenten, openbare lichamen en in de andere landen van het Koninkrijk wordt georganiseerd
Asks where and how the new identity cards will be implemented on the island, at whose cost, and whether a similar investment could upgrade the local identity card system and its backlog.
If these new identity cards are implemented here, at the expense of the State according to the proposal, the faction wants to know where and how exactly?
Indien deze nieuwe identiteitskaarten worden geïmplementeerd hier, volgens het voorstel ten koste van de Staat, wil de fractie weten waar en hoe precies?

Questions why the Paspoortwet is amended for a document unrelated to Sint Maarten and asks that the Staten be consulted on the change, and raises concern about data leaving the island for Dutch administration.
The faction asks for clarity on exactly what is meant by this amendment and that the Staten of Sint Maarten be asked to go along with this amendment.
De fractie vraagt voor duidelijkheid omtrent wat er precies wordt bedoeld met deze wijziging en dat de Staten van Sint Maarten wordt gevraagd om mee te gaan met deze wijziging.

Notes that the scope of the bill was understood not to cover persons outside the Dutch basic administration and asks whether the whole Kingdom's identity card systems should be upgraded with a say on how it is done.
The faction asks whether we should not upgrade our identity card systems throughout the Kingdom? And if so, would we not have the right to the way it is now done in the Netherlands?

De fractie vraagt of wij dan niet in het hele Koninkrijk onze identiteitskaart systemen zouden moeten upgraden? En zo ja, zouden we dan niet het recht hebben op de manier waarop het nu in Nederland wordt gedaan?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a draft Rijkswet implementing EU Regulation 2019/1157 on stronger security of identity cards, raising points on its scope, a missing transposition table, accessibility of the application procedure for people unable to appear in person, and application in the Caribbean public bodies (data protection and competent authority). The government's reply largely accepted the advice: it added a transposition table, clarified the scope and the Caribbean section, and withdrew the planned home-visit regulation, while maintaining that no statutory home-visit provision was needed.
concerns: The Afdeling advised adding a transposition table to the explanatory memorandum, which the government did.

The Afdeling asked for clarification of the scope of the regulation and of its application in the Caribbean public bodies, and for explicit statutory treatment of the home-visit possibility; the government clarified the explanatory memorandum but declined to codify home visits in law.

The Afdeling raised concern that dropping the exception for persons unable to appear in person could impede access to the application procedure; the government said existing home visits remain possible and removed the planned regulation on them.
The Afdeling advised that the Commissie toezicht bescherming persoonsgegevens BES be consulted or the omission explained; the government explained why no advice was sought.

35650-XIII.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, adjusting spending and receipts across policy articles such as the Tegemoetkoming Vaste Lasten, Groningen damage compensation, and energy and climate measures. It makes no changes to statutory powers, delegations, or oversight arrangements.
35650-XIII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by lower-than-expected uptake of schemes and new estimates from the Groningen damage institute, not by any new executive powers.
q: The budget for the TVL is reduced by € 300 million because a lower uptake of TVL 1.0 is expected than the originally estimated budget.
Het budget voor de TVL wordt met € 300 mln verlaagd omdat naar verwachting een lager beroep op de TVL 1.0 wordt gedaan dan het aanvankelijk geraamde budget.

35830-XIII.s: This is a budget amendment bill (Slotwet) that adjusts the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate and the budgets of its agencies to the realised figures. It sets out the amended expenditure, commitment and receipt amounts per policy article and agency, with the bill itself containing no delegation of rule-making power.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2020 is amended.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd.

35850-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget (first supplementary budget) of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget of the agency DUO, shifting appropriations across articles and adding coronavirus-related spending. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2021.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35925-XV.s: This bill adopts the departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (SZW) for 2022, setting expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros. The accompanying explanatory memorandum describes policy programmes, implementation bodies (UWV, SVB, gemeenten) and budget lines but contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2022 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that it has no remarks on the draft Budget Act 2022 for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) and recommends submitting it to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport states that some budgets require amendments, referring to annexes, without addressing any substantive objections.

36435-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (supplementary budget), changing expenditure and revenue figures across policy articles such as primary education, vocational education, and culture. It sets the budget amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 19 September 2023, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36550-XIII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2024 budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate and of its agencies, shifting spending and revenue across policy articles including Groningen earthquake compensation and the Nationaal Groeifonds contribution. It contains no delegation of rule-making power or changes to institutional checks, and it is an appropriation law with retroactive effect to 1 June 2024.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) and of the budget statement on agencies of this ministry, all for the year 2024.

Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2024.

36600-XIV.s: This bill fixes the 2025 budget statements for the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature (LVVN), including departmental expenditure and income, the NVWA agency budget, and the Diergezondheidsfonds. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 January 2025 or the day after publication.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2025 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

36600-XVI.s: This bill sets the departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport and the budgets of its agencies for 2025, in thousands of euros. The attached explanatory memorandum discusses health policy priorities such as workforce shortages, youth care, private equity in care, and budget horizontal developments, without introducing new delegated rule-making power.

36613-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget (departmental budget statement) of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, changing appropriations across policy articles on the economy, business innovation, energy and climate, Groningen, and the National Growth Fund. The explanatory memorandum describes reallocations, deferrals to later years and budget shifts, without delegating rule-making power.
q: The commitment amount for 2024 has been lowered by € 401.8 million.
Het verplichtingenbedrag in 2024 is verlaagd met € 401,8 mln.

36820-XIII.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, including the departmental budget and the agency budgets, through a September supplementary budget with reallocations across policy articles and an NGF-related cash shift. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective the day after publication, with retroactive effect to 16 September 2025.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII)

36838-(R2212).s: The bill amends the Dutch Kingdom Act on approval and publication of treaties to align it with digital publication in the Treaty Bank, shorten the publication period (from the first day of the second calendar month to the day itself), and allow annexes to be published electronically or by inspection. It also lets the Minister of Foreign Affairs set rules for publication and availability of the Treaty Gazette and Treaty Bank by ministerial regulation.
36838-(R2212).j: The memorandum justifies the shorter publication period by legal certainty and the existing digital practice, and notes that the obligation was meant for new treaties submitted to parliament after 1 July 2017 so that parliament can monitor new obligations.
q: Shortening the publication period contributes to legal certainty.
Het verkorten van de bekendmakingstermijn draagt bij aan rechtszekerheid.
d: rules on issuing the Treaty Gazette and keeping the Treaty Gazette and Treaty Bank available
minister may decide in special cases that treaty annexes are published by electronic reference or by inspection
p: The minister may decide in special cases that treaty annexes are not published in the Treaty Gazette but by electronic reference or inspection, with notice given in the Treaty Gazette as a safeguard.
The minister must keep the Treaty Bank electronically and publicly available free of charge, a transparency obligation rather than a shift of power.

parties: The VVD asks how shortening the publication period improves legal certainty, which touches on citizens' legal protection.
The members of the VVD faction ask the government for further explanation on the legal certainty of shortening the publication period.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering om nadere toelichting over de rechtszekerheid van het verkorten van de bekendmakingstermijn.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State of the Kingdom advised on a draft Rijkswet amending the Rijkswet goedkeuring en bekendmaking verdragen, making the Verdragenbank an official source of treaty data, and found no remarks, advising submission to parliament and the Caribbean legislatures. The government's nader rapport merely confirms that the proposal gives no reason for substantive comments and forwards the bill.

36850-XX.s: This second supplementary budget amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Asylum and Migration and the budget of the Immigration and Naturalisation Service (IND), mainly by reducing spending on reception, the Ukrainian displaced persons programme and COA. It does not delegate rule-making or shift powers away from checks; it is a budgetary adjustment expressed in thousands of euros.
36850-XX.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by a lower-than-expected asylum inflow under the mid-term production forecast, which reduces the expected reception costs at COA.
q: Because of this lower inflow, the expected average occupancy at COA falls to 74,362 persons.
Vanwege deze lagere instroom daalt de verwachte gemiddelde bezetting bij het COA naar 74.362 personen.

36915-XV.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2026 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, adjusting appropriations, expenditures and revenues across policy articles such as unemployment, social assistance, disability and childcare. The memorandum reflects coalition-agreement measures including abolishing the IVA benefit for new applicants from 2030, ending the transitional compensation scheme, and lowering the maximum daily wage.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment for the year 2026
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid voor het jaar 2026
